title: Atmospheric Sounds
short_description: Atmospheric ambience sounds for Mineclonia and VoxeLibre.
long_description: Atmospheric Sounds is a Luanti mod that layers ambient sounds on top of normal gameplay: weather, wildlife, caves, wind, water, and suspense layers. It is an unofficial port of CreativeMD's AmbientSounds 26.x (Minecraft) for Mineclonia and VoxeLibre, and is not affiliated with or endorsed by CreativeMD. The upstream Minecraft source tree is used as reference only and is not included. The package bundles 120 ambience OGG tracks (re-encoded to 64 kbps, ~41 MB total): animals (86), cave (15), wind (7), water (5), weather (4), suspense (3). No hard dependencies; the mod detects available game systems at startup (optional: mcl_worlds, mcl_weather, mcl_liquids, mcl_core, mcl_trees, vl_cavesounds, vl_env_sounds, mod_menu). Configurable via Luanti settings and optional Mod Menu tabs. Requires Luanti 5.10 or newer. Code and artwork by NeoSparkServers: LGPL-3.0-only. The 120 re-encoded sounds correspond to CreativeMD's upstream AmbientSounds; the checked upstream project declares LGPL-3.0-only. See LICENSE, NOTICE and SOUND_PROVENANCE.md for per-file source paths, attribution, and limitations of the provenance verification. AI disclosure: this port was developed with AI assistance for code, documentation, and packaging work; no bundled sound assets were generated by AI.
